identify.title: Identify mushroom
identify.subtitle: Upload photos from multiple views for more reliable identification

viewHint.front: Front or top view of the cap

identify.coachTip1: Front natural light; avoid strong backlight
identify.coachTip2: Fill the frame with the mushroom
identify.coachTip3: Include stem and base when possible
identify.coachTip4: More views = better guidance (never 100 percent safe)

coach.title: How to photograph this view
coach.policy: Field orientation only — better photos reduce confusions, never authorize consumption.

hint.file_tiny: File is very small: diagnostic detail may be missing.
hint.edge_small: Short edge is low-res: move closer or use more megapixels.
hint.aspect_extreme: Extreme aspect ratio: reframe the mushroom in the center.
hint.luma_dark: Very dark image: prefer front light (no blinding flash).
hint.luma_bright: Very bright image: avoid backlight and blown highlights.

gills.hymenium_visible: Are gills, pores, or folds of the hymenium visible?
gills.in_focus: Is focus on the hymenium (not the background)?
gills.not_top_only: Is the underside not fully hidden by the cap?

front.full_profile: Cap + stem + base all in frame?

habitat.substrate: Soil, wood, or host tree context visible?
habitat.context_scale: Is the growth context clear (step back)?

detail.macro_diag: Macro of volva, ring, or stem texture?
detail.clean_cut: Clean cut surface if any (never taste)?

identify.wizardSubtitle: Gills, profile, habitat and detail. Complete the critical ones before analyzing.

qualityHint.single: One photo is weak: the model abstains more often. Prefer underside + full profile.
qualityHint.pair: Good start (underside+profile). Add habitat + detail to cut lookalike risk.
qualityHint.full: Full 4-photo packet — best orientation signal (still never edible clearance).

multiviewNudge.single: With 1 photo the model abstains more often. Add underside + profile (2+) for a more stable cue — orientation only, never consumption.
multiviewNudge.pair: Solid packet (2+ views). Habitat and detail reduce lookalike confusions — no forage permission.

deadlyDiagnostic.coach: For deadly confusions: prioritize gills, full profile/stem, and base/volva/ring. Extra photos without those views are not enough — orientation only, never consumption.
deadlyDiagnostic.badgeTitle: Priority view for dangerous lookalike confusions (educational)

readiness.missing_habitat: Missing habitat view: improves ecological evidence (recommended).
readiness.missing_detail: Missing stem/ring/volva detail: reduces lookalike confusion.
readiness.missing_required: Critical views pending: {{views}}. You can submit with a warning, but open-set may reject.
readiness.hard_blocked: Strict mode: add critical views (gills and front) before analyzing.

identify.bannerLead: Take several photos (gills, profile, base). If the model is unsure, it abstains — better than inventing a name. Orientation only — never permission to consume.
identify.orientationSticky: Field orientation only · never permission to consume
identify.uploadTipsPolicy: Multi-view improves orientation; it never unlocks consumption. If evidence is thin, the app abstains.
identify.proCheck: No app is reliable for eating mushrooms. Use several photos (underside and profile), check lookalikes, and confirm with a mycologist if unsure.
identify.errorApiDown: API unavailable. Connect the backend to identify.
identify.errorQuota: Free limit of {{limit}} identifications/day reached. Enable Pro demo or come back tomorrow. Field orientation — not permission to consume.
identify.gpsPinLabel: Save local GPS pin in the notebook (lat/lng only · no EXIF · not a public map)

captureDensity.policy: Capture density · orientation only · never consumption permission

body.empty: Without photos there is no orientation ID.
body.missing_critical: Critical views still open. Incomplete packets abstain more often. Orientation only — never consumption permission.

body.ready: Underside + profile present. Still never consumption permission.
